proposal.reason: Main change is in transport behavior: P2P/SHM connection setup and teardown now use descriptor-based shared-memory resources, host/device stream synchronization is tightened during connect, and connect progress/reporting plus IPC address-table handling are changed. device-topology is additionally required because new ncclTopoCheckNet logic and NET-path bandwidth checks in topology path computation (including PCCL_NET_DISABLE_INTRA gating) alter the topology-based criteria used to choose transport paths.
